18.name: Episode 1
18.overview: 2016 winner Gary Maclean, who has gone on to become the first National Chef of Scotland, sets the challenges for four chefs seeking to make it through to the quarter-finals.

18.name: Episode 2
18.overview: The challenges for another group of contestants aiming for a place in the quarter-finals include preparing a dish of steamed razor clams and a dessert with authentic cranachan cream.

18.name: Episode 3
18.overview: It's the first quarter-final, and the chefs face an invention test demanding that they do something magical with an ingredient they will all have probably worked with before – king prawns!

18.name: Episode 4
18.overview: 2020 professional finalist Philli Armitage-Mattin sets the contestants a Korean-inspired skills test to make it through to the quarter-finals.

18.name: Episode 5
18.overview: Philli Armitage-Mattin sets the chefs a skills test challenge, using her own recipes. Two must recreate chicken wings stuffed with pork mince, the others, souffle pancakes with sake-poached plums.

18.name: Episode 6
18.overview: The chefs are challenged to create their own special twist on rice pudding, before serving up two plates of food to impress restaurant critics Jimi Famurewa, Jay Rayner and William Sitwell.

18.name: Episode 7
18.overview: 2022 champion Nikita Pathakji sets the week's new group of chefs the task of recreating her dish of king prawns served in a coconut and lemongrass broth.

18.name: Episode 8
18.overview: The chefs have just 20 minutes to prepare and cook a bavette steak served with a papaya and noodle salad, and crispy noodles.

18.name: Episode 9
18.overview: This week's quarter-finalists are faced with an invention test that must scream chicken, but which only includes off-cuts.

18.name: Episode 10
18.overview: 2018 finalist Matthew Ryle sets the competing chefs skills tests inspired by French classic cookery, highlighting just what you can achieve with red mullet and roasted poussin.

18.name: Episode 11
18.overview: 2018 finalist Matthew Ryle sets the skills test challenges: raviolo stuffed with pea and ricotta and poached pear mille-feuille with a hazelnut praline cream.

18.name: Episode 12
18.overview: The last group of quarter-finalists must do something magical with mince if they are to make it through to knockout week.

18.name: Episode 13
18.overview: Knockout week has arrived. It will see the best 13 chefs who have cooked their way through the heats and quarter-finals face an invention test.

18.name: Episode 14
18.overview: Knockout week continues as the ten remaining professional chefs are split into two groups. The first five head to Boxhall in central London to meet Marcus and Monica for their first challenge.

18.name: Episode 15
18.overview: It's the end of knockout week and time for the second group of five professional contestants to enter the world of pop-ups as they head out of the MasterChef kitchen for the first time in the competition.

18.name: Episode 16
18.overview: The semi-finals begin with the remaining eight chefs challenged to deliver a dish that uses all the chosen ingredients, with absolutely nothing wasted.

18.name: Episode 17
18.overview: The six semi-finalists are asked to cook their own Thai-style dish from a larder of ingredients selected by John Chantarasak.

18.name: Episode 18
18.overview: The semi-finalists are whisked off to the stunning Scottish Highlands, where maestro Mark Donald puts them to work at The Glenturret Lalique, a two-Michelin-star restaurant.

18.name: Episode 19
18.overview: Finals week has arrived, along with the biggest challenge the four remaining in the competition have faced in their careers: cooking for 27 of the UK and Ireland's leading chefs at the Goring Hotel.

18.name: Episode 20
18.overview: The three chefs left standing head off for an Italian culinary adventure in South Tyrol, where they help prepare a lunch service at the three-Michelin-starred Atelier Moessmer.

18.name: Episode 21
18.overview: Just one cook-off stands between the three remaining chefs and the title of MasterChef: The Professionals 2026 champion.

19.name: Episode 1
19.overview: Six ambitious chefs enter the MasterChef kitchen ready to prove they have what it takes to succeed in the competition. Across two demanding challenges, they’ll need to demonstrate their skills.

19.name: Episode 2
19.overview: The remaining five chefs return to the kitchen for two demanding challenges that will push their skills, creativity and ambition to the limit as they battle for a place in the quarter-final.

19.name: Episode 3
19.overview: It’s the first quarter-final, and the four chefs who have fought their way through the heats return to the kitchen with everything to play for.

19.name: Episode 4
19.overview: In the second week of the heats, a fresh group of professional chefs wait in the wings of the kitchen ready to demonstrate their exceptional talent.

19.name: Episode 5
19.overview: Marcus and Monica are joined by special guest Alex Claridge, the chef behind The Wilderness in Birmingham, who sets the contestants the challenge of recreating a dish that demands great precision.

19.name: Episode 6
19.overview: The standout chefs from the week’s heats battle it out again in the quarter-final. The stakes are higher, the challenges more demanding, and the judges’ expectations are greater than ever.

19.name: Episode 7
19.overview: The third week of heats gets under way as six more ambitious professional chefs enter the kitchen.

19.name: Episode 8
19.overview: Five chefs remain in the race for a spot in the quarter-final. But two more high-pressure challenges which will test every aspect of their cooking stand in their way.

19.name: Episode 9
19.overview: The four chefs who have survived the intensity of the heats are back in the kitchen. Now they must prove that they have the skills to take on the next level of the competition.

19.name: Episode 10
19.overview: The final week of heats continues as another group of ambitious professional chefs steps up to prove they have the talent and technique to progress in the competition.

19.name: Episode 11
19.overview: Five chefs remain in the race for a spot in the quarter-final, but first they must impress in two more challenges designed to test their creativity, precision and technical ability.

19.name: Episode 12
19.overview: It’s the last quarter-final of the series, and with a place in knockout week at stake, there’s everything to play for.

19.name: Episode 13
19.overview: Knockout week is here, and the 12 remaining chefs face their toughest test yet as seafood maestro Paul Ainsworth challenges them to reinvent one of Britain’s best-loved dishes: fish and chips.

19.name: Episode 14
19.overview: Five of the remaining chefs face the pressure of cooking in the real world, with places in the semi-finals at stake.

19.name: Episode 15
19.overview: The second group of chefs step out of the MasterChef kitchen and into the competitive world of pop-up dining.

lastEpisodeToAir.overview: The standout chefs from the week’s heats battle it out again in the quarter-final. The stakes are higher, the challenges more demanding, and the judges’ expectations are greater than ever.

nextEpisodeToAir.overview: The third week of heats gets under way as six more ambitious professional chefs enter the kitchen.

overview: The hunt for a young chef who wants to make it to the top of the culinary world.

seasons.name: Season 16
seasons.overview: The show returns for its sixteenth series as 32 ambitious chefs from across the country battle to become the 2023 champion.  Presiding over the UK’s most revered cooking competition are Michelin-starred chef Marcus Wareing, renowned chef Monica Galetti and celebrated MasterChef judge Gregg Wallace, all eager to discover a brand new culinary star.  Over seven weeks, the 32 professional chefs will have their skills, creativity and culinary knowledge put to the test in a series of demanding challenges as the judges hunt out the most impressive talent in the industry. Only the best will be in with a chance of winning the coveted trophy.

title: MasterChef: The Professionals
